strings.en: At this pace, about 14 looks a day, you'll run out 6 days before the reset. <0>Try it on hides while you're out, and Store Chat keeps working.</0> Looks you add last 12 months and are used after your plan's looks.

strings.en: Add 80 looks for $5 when 5% are left

strings.en: You approved it in Shopify. We never charge above it, and we tell you at 90% of your cap.
strings.ar: وافقت عليه في Shopify. لا نحاسبك فوقه أبداً، وننبهك عند بلوغ 90% منه.

strings.en: 350 looks, Store Chat included. <0>Billed by Shopify with your other apps.</0> Next bill on 18 October.

strings.en: At your pace, about 430 looks a month, Growth with one 80-look top-up comes to $34. Pro would be $49, so staying on Growth is cheaper. We'll tell you if that changes.
